These AirPods work much better than I expected. I was concerned at first that they might fall out of my ears due to their design but was pleasantly surprised when they didn’t. I can even shake my head around and these buds aren’t moving. I was also impressed with the battery capacity of the charging case and it compares well with other brands like the Bose sport earbuds I also own. Unfortunately like all small electronics the battery life is around four hours before they run out of juice, hence the need for a second pair but is still impressive for the size of the buds. Overall I am very pleased with this purchase and would buy again.
